name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Private double-track follow-up to the working single-track reversible lightrail prototype.
description: Revision 14 adds UM Lightrail Double (Test), based on native separated double-tram lane offsets plus the working mixed tram/railtram modes. Existing single-track resources, stops and saved objects remain unchanged. The user confirmed that revision 13 supports a complete line, depot access, Citylink movement, door operations, automatic terminal reversal and save/reload persistence. Those results apply to the single-track prototype only. This version first tests the double-track connection between existing single-track Bidirectional Stops; two-track stations and crossovers are later work. New network junctions, line path selection, one-track-per-direction use and multiple-vehicle safety remain unproven. Use a copy of the validated save and replace only the connecting track. No automatic conversions, hidden loops or vehicle commands.
